scenarios.prompt: A2D character face changes size in every generated idle frame. Bake one coherent action from pinned head/body parts with fixed bone lengths, then run independent image/ratio/temporal validation without changing gameplay timing. Do not claim rigid baking automatically proves visual quality.

criteria.ownership: Own source identity and sequence continuity; atlas import and gameplay timing retain their existing owners.
criteria.measurement: Require independent hash-bound actual-image landmarks, absolute head/face dimensions, anatomical ratios and authored projection/contacts.
criteria.evidence: Reject missing/stale/failing evidence, inspect fixed-scale playback and loop residuals, and redraw distorted art rather than masking it with whole-frame scaling.
